description: This file defines the EditViewMetaParser class, a PHP class that extends MetaParser to parse and extract metadata from HTML files representing SugarCRM's EditView forms, and generate equivalent PHP array definitions for the edit views.

classes.name: EditViewMetaParser
classes.description: A class that extends MetaParser to parse SugarCRM's EditView HTML files and produce a structured PHP array representation of the view's metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the parser with the view type 'EditView'.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method to parse an HTML file representing an EditView, extract relevant metadata, and produce a PHP array or file contents representing the view configuration.
